result.summary: TASK-010 executed: demo@youhan.in provisioned in the governed demo seed as the single client-facing login, with its boundaries proven against that address rather than against its role.
unexpectedFindings: The client persona inserted mid-list in userSpecs renumbers every employeeCode after it, so a top-up seed collides on EmployeeProfile.employeeNumber and dies on P2002. Invisible on the fresh path; found only through prepare-test-db.mjs, which seeds without --reset. Fixed by appending last.
CL-007 was resolved to Option A and built, but its clarification entry still read OPEN — the corpus disagreed with the code. Transcribed, and the lateness recorded rather than quietly corrected.
docs/DEMO.md carried stale population figures (40 of 41, 1800 attendance). Corrected to 41 of 42 and 1845.
APP_URL in .env pins the E2E suite to port 3005, so the committed webServer gate cannot attach to a dev server on 3000. Environmental; no repository file was changed for it.
scopeDeviations: The seed, test and documentation edits were made BEFORE this session was opened and before the VERIFYING -> IMPLEMENTING transition. The order was wrong: CHG-004's conflict surfaced during the work rather than before it. Recorded rather than presented as clean; scope-check reports the two SDD-V052 attribution warnings that follow from it.

TASK-009 prohibits apps/web/prisma/. Rather than widen it in place, TASK-010 was written to declare the wider scope, because the prohibition's recorded reason (designation needs no seed change) became false when the login was given a new address.
newUnknowns: Whether the Product Owner accepts CHG-004's narrow amendment to DATA-005, or requires the client login to move back to a reserved domain.
Whether any mailbox actually exists at demo@youhan.in. The seed never dispatches, so nothing depends on it today, but a real domain implies a real MX and that has not been checked.

Whether prepare-test-db.mjs discarding the seed's stderr should be changed. It hid a genuine P2002 behind 'the seed failed (exit 1)'; the credential-safety reason for capturing it is sound, but the error type could be surfaced without the banner.
